descriptions.w3d_component_list_get_800af330: Returns the global registry list that tracks every instance of this component type.
descriptions.w3d_component_unlink_800af33c: Removes a component from its type registry list and decrements the registry count.
descriptions.w3d_component_create_800af380: Allocates a component, runs the base constructor, installs its vtable, registers it and increments the count.
descriptions.w3d_component_release_800af3f0: Drops one reference; when none remain, unlinks the component and destroys it through the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_component_retain_800af458: Adds one reference and returns the previous reference count.
descriptions.w3d_component_handle_message_800af470: On message 64 runs the base handler then a follow-up step; on 66 runs another step first; otherwise defers to the base.
descriptions.w3d_component_stop_800af4f8: Empty handler step that does nothing.
descriptions.w3d_component_update_800af4fc: Touches the component's resource, then refreshes it when active or applies a value when no blocking flag bits are set.
